# UND Scholarly Commons

> > UND Scholarly Commons is the University of North Dakota's institutional repository and open-access platform for preserving, sharing, and discovering scholarly research, datasets, and educational resources.

UND Scholarly Commons serves as the central hub for University of North Dakota's research output, hosting peer-reviewed publications, dissertations, theses, datasets, open educational resources, and books. The platform is managed by Chester Fritz Library and provides access to research collections from across UND's colleges, departments, and research centers.

## Getting Started

- [UND Scholarly Commons Homepage](https://commons.und.edu): Homepage for UND Scholarly Commons institutional repository and open-access research platform
- [About Institutional Repositories](https://commons.und.edu/about.html): About page explaining institutional repositories and UND Scholarly Commons mission
- [Submit Your Research](https://commons.und.edu/submit_research.html): Guidelines and instructions for submitting research to UND Scholarly Commons
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://commons.und.edu/faq.html): FAQs about research deposits, copyright, open access, and repository usage

## Browse Research Collections

- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://commons.und.edu/communities.html): Browse research collections by UND departments, colleges, and research units
- [Schools, Colleges, and Departments](http://commons.und.edu/communities): Directory of UND schools, colleges, and departments with research collections
- [Browse Journals and Peer-Reviewed Series](https://commons.und.edu/peer_review_list.html): Directory of peer-reviewed journals and scholarly publications hosted on Commons
- [Most Popular Papers](https://commons.und.edu/topdownloads.html): Curated list of most downloaded and popular research papers from Commons
- [Most Recent Additions](https://commons.und.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added scholarly works and archival content to UND Scholarly Commons

## Specialized Collections

- [Datasets](http://commons.und.edu/data): Research data repository for UND datasets and open data collections
- [Open Educational Resources](http://commons.und.edu/oers): Repository of open educational resources and faculty-created course materials
- [Books](https://commons.und.edu/books): Collection of open-access books authored by UND faculty and researchers

## Account & Alerts

- [User Login](https://commons.und.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User authentication and account login page for UND Commons
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://commons.und.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feed subscription management for repository content

## Repository Information

- [Policies](https://commons.und.edu/policies.html): Repository policies covering copyright, preservation, and metadata management
- [Activity by Year](https://commons.und.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and annual growth metrics for UND Scholarly Commons
